body: Polo G brought the Rolling Loud energy to Arizona State University, pulling up on campus ahead of the release of Rolling Loud: The Movie The Chicago rapper surprised students with a performance as Rolling Loud takes its college tour to ASU. The upcoming film hits theaters October 2 and stars Owen Wilson, Matt Rife, Christian Convery and Henry Winkler, with appearances from Travis Scott @travisscott, Sexyy Red @sexyyred, Ty Dolla $ign and Ski Mask the Slump God.

source_caption_text:
Polo G brought the Rolling Loud energy to Arizona State University, pulling up on campus ahead of the release of Rolling Loud: The Movie 🔥🎬

The Chicago rapper surprised students with a performance as Rolling Loud takes its college tour to ASU. The upcoming film hits theaters October 2 and stars Owen Wilson, Matt Rife, Christian Convery and Henry Winkler, with appearances from Travis Scott, Sexyy Red, Ty Dolla $ign and Ski Mask the Slump God.

From the festival stage to a college campus and now the big screen, Rolling Loud is bringing hip-hop to a whole new audience 👀
